title: Wall Mount 18-Inch Towel Bar (Malibu Collection) - Solid Brass Straight Bar | Allied Brass
body_html:
Add sleek, wall-mounted towel storage with the Malibu collection towel bar, featuring an 18-inch center-to-center straight bar crafted from solid brass.

  • Contemporary style that complements designer bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories
  • Solid brass construction for enduring everyday use
  • Wall-mounted installation saves floor space
  • All mounting hardware included; no assembly required
  • Coordinate with matching Malibu accessories for a cohesive, statement bath accessories look

Specs

  • Center-to-center: 18-Inch
  • Overall length: 20-Inch
  • Projection (depth): 3.39-Inch
  • Height: 2-Inch
  • Bar diameter: 0.5-Inch
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Wall Mount
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Finish options: Available in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors.

_previous.title: Malibu 18 inch Towel Bar
_previous.description: The Malibu towel bar will add a sleek contemporary look to your bathroom. Crafted out of solid brass, the Malibu towel bar offers the quality and design found in high-end bath accessories but at a very affordable price. The bar comes in both 18” or 24” and is available in a wide variety of colors. Match it together with the coordinating Malibu Hand Towel Holder, Malibu Toilet Tissue Holder and Malibu Robe Hook to complete your bathroom decor.
